Musée National de la Marine, Paris

Location17 Pl. du Trocadéro et du 11 Novembre, 75116 Paris, France
Visited19 September 2016
WebsiteMusée national de la Marine de Paris

Museum Report

The Musée National de la Marine operates branches in Brest, Port-Louis, Paris, Rochefort and Toulon.

The Paris branch museum is located in the ground floor of the Palais de Chaillot – just across the seine river from the Eifel tower. Notwithstanding the fairly grand location, it is a relatively small museum, and when I went there in 2016 the main attraction from my perspective was a collection of models of various French warships. But they appeared to be undertaking a renovation, and from the look of their website it would appear that the museum may have been considerably enhanced since then.
